newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian gunmen wound Israeli motorist.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian gunmen wound Israeli motorist.

text.p: Palestinian gunmen shot and wounded an Israeli motorist in a village near Jerusalem early on Saturday, security sources said.
The army said that at least one gunman hit a woman driving a car at Har Adar near the Jerusalem-Tel Aviv highway. The victim, who was not named, was in moderate condition, it added.
The security sources said it was the most serious shooting incident since Israel broke ground on the controversial Jewish settlement at Har Homa near Jerusalem two months ago.
